Messages.Author: Chick Lewis
Messages.Body:
If the Sengir Dagger is in play, can my Ravnos use Horrid Reality to
create a temporary illusory Sengir Dagger if that is the first
equipment card in my library? I would say yes, since the dagger
illusion goes to the ash heap at the end of the combat. Opinions?

Chick...@msn.com

Messages.Author: Drake Coker
Messages.Body:
> If the Sengir Dagger is in play, can my Ravnos use Horrid Reality to
> create a temporary illusory Sengir Dagger if that is the first
> equipment card in my library? I would say yes, since the dagger
> illusion goes to the ash heap at the end of the combat. Opinions?

> Chick...@msn.com

I would agree. First of all, if it is contested, then it leads
to a whole series of unclear questions about what happens. It is
just plain easier to allow it.

On the simulation side, it is just an illusion, so uniqueness doesn't
make sense. Not that this matters in terms of the rules, but it
is always nice when a ruling matches the "real-world".

- Drake

Messages.Author: Chick Lewis
Messages.Body:
Drake, I agree completely with your points. Thanks. Anybody else
have different opinions?

Chick...@msn.com

> illusion goes to the ash heap at the end of the combat. Opinions?
>

I think that the two would instantly go into contestation. This would
mean that the illusionary Dagger would be useless, but that the "real" Dagger
would be unusable until the beggining of that player's turn.
